description: tags follows written-terminator priority. Two completed items of r span B C T. The one tagged BAD leaves out [T] after y, although the same prefix reads y and then the written T, so it has no eligible witness. Only the one tagged GOOD counts, so the text's tags are GOOD alone (engine §4, §10).
grammar:
%elidable T
%rule text B C T
%tags tags($, r)
%rule r B y [T] T <BAD> | B C T <GOOD>
%rule y C
